messages:
maria_cs: Heads-up — we have a set of high-touch onboarding customers who saw elevated 5xx rates during yesterday's embedding ingestion window. Need a short, staged comms plan + exec-brief offer for renewal-risk accounts. Draft below, please review and flag tone/comp offsets.

maria_cs: Proposed public-facing update (to send via email + support portal):

---
Hi {CustomerName},

We wanted to let you know about an ingestion disruption that affected some onboarding jobs on 2024-12-14 between 03:10–04:05 UTC. Our team identified a request-routing regression that led to intermittent 5xx errors for a subset of tenant ingest jobs.

What we did: we rolled a fix and increased capacity on the dedicated pools, retried failed jobs, and applied additional circuit-breaking to prevent retries from overwhelming the downstream workers.

Next steps for you: if you still see failed records, reply to this message with the job id and we will re-run them on priority.

What we're offering: for impacted customers in active onboarding we will:
- schedule a 30-min exec briefing with an engineering lead
- provide a one-month credit against ingestion fees
- a free enablement session (30–60 min) on retry-safe ingest patterns and best practices

We're sorry for the disruption and are tracking follow-ups in your support ticket {TicketID}.

Regards,
The Redwood Inference Ops Team
---

maria_cs: Questions: 1) Is the rollback/fix wording accurate? 2) Is the credit offer reasonable for renewals folks? 3) Any additional ask for enablement labs?

kimberly_csm: +1 to the tone, concise and apologetic. For renewal-risk accounts we should move the exec briefing to a 45-min slot and include a tailored cost/latency report. Also call out SLA credit eligibility explicitly.

alex_eng: Rollback -> we didn't rollback; we patched routing policy and increased pool targets. Suggest replacing "rolled a fix" with "deployed a routing policy patch and scaled dedicated pools".

maria_cs: Good catch, updated.

simon_sre: For the postmortem phrase we should avoid technical detail overload. Maybe link to a short RCA doc instead of listing everything in the customer email. Also confirm remediation timestamp: the correct window ended at 04:10 UTC, not 04:05.

maria_cs: Noted — will change window to 03:10–04:10 UTC and include RCA link: https://redwood.internal/rca/2024-12-14-ingest-routing

jordan_support: Support-side checklist for outreach: 
- tag affected accounts in Zendesk with "ingest-2024-12-14"
- queue re-run requests into priority job pipeline (label: cs-priority)
- create a follow-up survey template to capture enablement feedback

jordan_support: Quick snippet for re-run request (copy into support reply):
```
Please reply with the ingestion job ID(s). We'll re-run the failed batches on our priority queue and confirm completion here.
```

maria_cs: Love the snippet — will add to the template.

exec-ops: For top-tier renewal accounts, recommend we offer a live architecture deep-dive (60 min) + an executive check-in with CS director. That helps with churn prevention.

kimberly_csm: Agree. Also propose we flag renewal touchpoints in Gainsight and nudge AE two business days after the exec-brief finishes.

alex_eng: From engineering: we also want to offer a short checklist customers can run to avoid duplicate retries (idempotency tips). Putting a small guide into the enablement deck is low effort.

maria_cs: Action items: 
- kimberly_csm: update email to 45/60 min slots for renewal-risk accounts and add SLA credit sentence (due EOD)
- alex_eng: prepare a 10-slide enablement deck + idempotency checklist (due tomorrow noon)
- simon_sre: confirm final RCA link and remediation timestamps (due in 2 hours)
- jordan_support: prepare support snippets and Zendesk tags (due 3 hours)
- exec-ops: identify top 8 renewal accounts to receive exec-brief invites (due EOD)

deploy-bot: Notice: Incident 2024-12-14-ingest-routing status changed to: post-incident-review (link: https://redwood.internal/incidents/2024-12-14-ingest-routing).

maria_cs: Thanks team — I'll queue the first outbound batch after kimberly and simon sign off. Also capturing feedback plan: post-brief survey + optional follow-up 1:1.

kimberly_csm: Signed off on wording with changes. Sending updated copy in thread in 20m.

simon_sre: RCA link confirmed and timestamps validated.

maria_cs: Sending first wave to impacted onboarding customers now. Will post a follow-up thread with customer responses and any escalations.
